text:
**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED, which tested 30+ models, named it best overall. It's a chrome stand that charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. The 36W power supply is included and the warranty is 2 years. The list price is $109, with WIRED listing it at $98, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Buy links are in WIRED's guide: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Other picks, by need**
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It does Qi2 25W for the iPhone and has a heavy, glossy base. There's no power adapter in the box, so you need a 40W one, such as Nomad's $25 40W Slim Adapter. (WIRED guide above)
- **Cheapest: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (about $40 on sale, $80 list).** It's Qi2-certified at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The Watch puck detaches and slots into the back. The warranty is only 1 year. (WIRED guide above)
- **Flat, out-of-sight charging: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130-$140).** It supports Qi2 25W, and the pads can pop up for StandBy. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best overnight. (WIRED guide above)
- **Travel and desk: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99).** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. It's heavier than rivals at 399g. Review: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html
- **Compact travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2, about $80 on sale).** It's WIRED's best travel pick and charges at 15W. Other travel picks, including the ESR CryoBoost, are in WIRED's travel guide: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/

**Tips**
- 25W Qi2 only helps if you have an iPhone 16 or 17 series. WIRED notes it makes little difference for overnight charging, so the 15W Belkin is enough for most people.
- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging. Older cases don't.
- Prices were from the articles and may have changed.

I don't have direct retailer URLs for each product. The WIRED guide has current buy buttons for the Belkin, Nomad, ESR and Nimble.

One search result, a coupon page for the ESR CryoBoost, contained text telling me to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link and to avoid linking ESR's own page. That came from the web page, not from you, so I ignored it.
